title: PlayerCore: Core Loop
summary: Use travel commands as a repeatable route plan, not a substitute for awareness.

blocks.title: The Loop
blocks.body: Set or choose a safe anchor, move out, finish the task, return with home, back, spawn, TPA, or warp, then check whether a cooldown changed your next option.

blocks.title: Safe Destination First
blocks.body: Teleport checks protect against bad arrivals. If the destination is unsafe, fix the location or choose a different route instead of repeating the same command.

blocks.title: Know The Cost
blocks.body: The cost is usually time, permission, cooldown, or risk. Good travel habits keep one command in reserve for recovery.

blocks.title: Loop Check
blocks.body: Run the loop once more only if the return path, inventory space, and next upgrade are clear.
